name: Adwaita 24H Lockscreen Clock & Weather
description: Replaces the default lock screen clock with a customizable Libadwaita 24H/12H hybrid analog-digital clock, sticky live preview, global locale-aware architecture (auto/custom weekday start, auto regional units, 15 UI languages, 22 numeral systems, and regional secondary calendars including Hijri, Persian, Chinese, Japanese, Buddhist, Indian, Ethiopic, and ISO Week). Uses unlock-dialog session mode and free public APIs (Open-Meteo, ipwho.is, BigDataCloud).
